summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release disclosing assay results from twelve diamond drill holes at its Guayabales project in Colombia. The results show high-grade gold intercepts in the Ramp Zone and broad mineralization in the Apollo breccia body. The filing is a routine disclosure of exploration results and operational updates. No special-situation corporate event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change — is announced or implied by the filing.
